# Machine Learning — end-to-end PyTorch + scikit-learn pipelines with interpretability

Curated by Skill Harbor — @itallstartedwithaidea's machine-learning skill, listed here with credit to its creator: an end-to-end ML pipeline construction guide that bridges the gap between a working notebook and a production pipeline. It enforces software-engineering discipline for experiments — version-controlled runs, deterministic training, proper train/validation/test splits with stratified cross-validation, systematic hyperparameter optimization with Optuna, learning-curve analysis, and interpretability as a first-class requirement (SHAP values, feature importance, partial dependence plots for every model — no black-box predictions for scientific or business-critical applications). It includes platform compatibility notes (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Claude Code, Cline, aider), a mermaid pipeline diagram, and working PyTorch implementation code. Honest caveats: the repo is commercially branded ("Agent Skills™ by googleadsagent.ai™") but the skill itself is substantive and free; deep learning examples assume GPU availability for reasonable training times; classical ML coverage is thin next to the dedicated scikit-learn skills — pair accordingly. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
